broken_string: multi-byte character
cases.note: The crate reads bytes, so the emoji's UTF-8 bytes pass its character check and it fails later with LatitudeCoordError (2306360.53104 at byte 10). polytini reports the invalid character at index 12.

cases.name: invalid_string
cases.note: The crate returns DecodeError at index 12, where its 64-bit shift would overflow. polytini throws overflow at index 10, where the value passes 2^53.

cases.name: another_invalid_string
cases.note: The crate returns LatitudeCoordError (49775.95019): it ends the last value at the end of the string (issue 55). polytini throws truncated.

cases.name: bad_coords: latitude 430.252
cases.note: The crate rejects latitudes outside [-90, 90] and longitudes outside [-180, 180]. polytini does not range-check: any number the format can hold is encoded.
